nome_jp: モモスター　キャンベロ
testo:
Guard Strike
Speed Attacker
■ When you put this creature or when you reveal this creature to your opponent with the "Guard Strike" ability, destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has "blocker".
■ Shinkapower: When this creature evolves, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.
